Path-Headland.dc.html.title: Learning path · opened from Help → Learn

n1.text:
MAIN UX DECISIONS

• Help is the starting point: it keeps the tractor screen visible and pauses its controls. Tapping a control shows a short description, More info and a QR code (as on current SmartTouch) without activating anything.
• 'Learn' hands over to the Skill Tree: a separate screen with that control's task-based path — Understand → Practise (stationary simulation) → Apply at work.
• Progress shows exploration only, never certification. No points, streaks or badges.
• Practice shows one question at a time, marks a 'Suggested' answer, never says 'wrong', and allows Skip / Back / Exit.
• A pulsing blue outline marks the next tap for demos (Tweaks → Demo → showHints).

n2.text:
ASSUMPTIONS (no info in references)

• Tractor image: the team's SmartTouch crop, with its baked-in FRONT PTO help card removed and edges faded.
• Names of the controls in the image are NOT verified (shown as 'Control A–H [name to verify]'); only Front PTO and the AUTO label come from the screenshot.
• 'Headland' is an added prototype control (left column), not a confirmed SmartTouch icon.
• Help card layout and QR placement are modelled on the screenshot; the QR is a placeholder.
• Canvas 1280×800; Barlow as a stand-in typeface.

n3.text:
WHERE SIMULATED CONTENT APPEARS

• Yellow dashed chip = simulated data; grey dashed box = placeholder for verified documentation.
• A0: task status, all Help texts (only Headland has an illustrative text), placeholder QR.
• Learning path: 'Why now' task context.
• Step 1: example use case and diagram. Step 2: all questions and feedback. Step 3: reminder toggle.

n4.text:
VERIFY BEFORE OPERATOR TESTING

• Real names and Help texts for every control in the image (SmartTouch Help).
• Which SmartTouch control opens headland management, and where it sits.
• Headland-sequence behaviour, setup and terminology (Valtra docs).
• Where the QR code should lead.
• Wording of practice feedback with a domain expert.
• Turn showHints off for unbiased tests.

n5.text:
HOW TO EDIT

• Headlines and labels: double-click and retype on the artboard.
• Help texts, names and card positions: the scenario() block at the top of the A0 script (Code view). h1–h10 are the image's controls.
• Practice questions and feedback: scenario() in Step 2.
• Hints: select an artboard → Tweaks → Demo → showHints.
• Links are plain <a href="…dc.html">; press Play on any artboard to click through.
